"1904.10644v1": {
    "blocks": ["natgrad", "stein"],
    "mech": "Certainty-weighted continual updates: per-parameter natural-gradient steps scaled by uncertainty (uncertain effects adapt fastest, Delta_i ~ sigma_i^2 * gradient_i). The reservoir replay buffer is replaced by a ~200-game Stein coreset: greedy kernel-herding selection refreshed quarterly, minimizing MMD to the full history.",
    "desc": "certainty-weighted-continual-updates",
    "why": "Gate needs 1887-style metric replication on walk-forward data.",
},
# 1
"1905.03628v1": {
    "blocks": ["poisson"],
    "mech": "Nested conditional Poisson for in-play totals: the underdog's second-half scoring rate is conditioned on the favorite's realized first-half points (log lambda_underdog2H = gamma_0 + gamma_1*favorite strength + gamma_2*favorite 1H points), capturing garbage-time and protect-the-lead effects inside a nested Monte Carlo score simulation.",
    "desc": "nested-poisson-totals",
    "why": "Gate needs holdout log-loss gain >= 0.005 with gamma_2 significant.",
},
# 2
"1905.07886": {
    "blocks": ["conformal"],
    "mech": "Normalized nonconformity (NCP) prediction intervals [yhat - sigmahat*qhat, yhat + sigmahat*qhat] with per-game dispersion estimates; a rolling-window (never random-split) calibration design for ordered NFL data; a per-market path-selection protocol over {plain CP, NCP} x point predictor; ICM martingale monitoring for concept drift.",
    "desc": "conformal-ncp-intervals",
    "why": "Gate needs 2025-holdout nominal coverage within 2pp at no wider mean width.",
},
# 3
"1908.05745": {
    "blocks": ["nmf"],
    "mech": "NMF-derived archetypal target zones from prior-season data serve as the NHPP intensity surface for NFL targets, with a completion/success mark model taking fitted intensity as a covariate; QBs and receivers are clustered into 5 style archetypes for matchup-typing and DFS stacking.",
    "desc": "nmf-target-archetypes",
    "why": "Gate needs QB replication: xi != 0 winning on held-out log-loss for most qualifying QBs.",
},
# 4
"1908.07372": {
    "blocks": ["kalman"],
    "mech": "NFL in-play SDE model: X(t) = score differential minus required pace differential, with team-pair Ornstein-Uhlenbeck/Brownian parameters fit from 2010-2024 play-by-play and closed-form P(win|t); a discrete-shock layer perturbs drift on turnovers/injuries with relaxation; implied sigma doubles as a totals-modeling volatility feature.",
    "desc": "sde-inplay-win-probability",
    "why": "Gate needs 2023-2024 in-play Brier >= 0.005 better than the naive baseline.",
},
# 5
"1909.12938v1": {
    "blocks": ["tsf"],
    "mech": "Per-player weekly time-series forecast stage (gradient-boosted TS with opponent/situational features plus a probabilistic availability model) feeding the ILP/MILP DFS lineup optimizer, replacing trailing-average forecasts; validated with a rolling-origin backtest requiring >= 5% realized-points gain on 2022-2024 slates.",
    "desc": "ts-forecast-dfs-optimizer",
    "dir": "props-dfs",
    "why": "Gate needs rolling 2022-2024 backtest: TS lineups beat trailing-average lineups by >= 5%.",
},
# 6
"1910.08858v2": {
    "blocks": ["scoring"],
    "mech": "Empirical spread-panel to win-probability table: P(Win|PS) by half-point bucket from The Odds API plus GSE's backtest archive, as an odds-lane feature; with a walk-forward +EV screen comparing de-vigged consensus moneylines against model win probability at achievable lines with fractional-Kelly sizing (engine-honesty screen, never a profit objective).",
    "desc": "spread-win-probability-table",
    "why": "Gate needs 2022-2025 holdout ECE <= 2pp on the spread->win-rate table.",
},
# 7
"1911.08138": {
    "blocks": ["hmm", "lasso"],
    "mech": "SparseFormHMM: 2-3 latent form states with state-varying intercept, LASSO plus relaxed-LASSO covariate screening via smooth-|.| on a 50-value log-spaced lambda grid with BIC selection, and time-gap-aware transitions for irregular NFL event spacing; posterior form-state probabilities feed player-prop and game models.",
    "desc": "sparse-form-hmm",
    "why": "Gate needs >= 0.005 log-loss gain on 2022-2024 FG holdout and 75/100 clean simulation replications.",
},
# 8
"1911.08791": {
    "blocks": ["poisson", "negbin"],
    "mech": "Three-module Bayesian factorization: Module 1 home/away points ~ Poisson/NB on pre-game EPA-based unit ratings; Module 2 Bernoulli on the close-margin bucket; Module 3 Bernoulli on win; one posterior yielding coherent P(win), P(cover), P(over), fit with weekly expanding windows.",
    "desc": "three-module-score-factorization",
    "why": "Gate needs joint Brier win on >= 2 of 3 markets vs independent modules on 2025 holdout.",
},
# 9
"1912.10417v1": {
    "blocks": ["hmm", "joi"],
    "mech": "Per-player 2-state Markov switching on per-drive smoothed fantasy-points-above-expectation to classify hot/cold regimes, then ARIMAX/logistic on regime labels with on-field co-presence dummies (WR2 in route tree, backup RB on 3rd down) producing a signed synergy network; QB<->WR positive edges become DFS stack candidates.",
    "desc": "regime-switching-synergy-network",
    "why": "Gate needs regimes real (not k-artifacts) and synergies replicating at >= +1.5 pts/game, p < 0.05.",
},
# 10
"2001.04197v4": {
    "blocks": ["rcd"],
    "mech": "RCD quarantine layer over the ~35-indicator set: reimplemented RCD (ancestor loop with least-squares residualization, parent filtering, bi-directed marking); any indicator pair joined by a bi-directed edge in >= 60% of bootstrap runs is quarantined -- neither may be used as a cause in narrative content and at most one enters the prediction stack.",
    "desc": "rcd-quarantine-layer",
    "why": "Gate needs Brier parity within 0.002 with >= 15% of directed edges removed as confounded.",
},
# 11
"2002.01193": {
    "blocks": ["hmm", "copula"],
    "mech": "CopulaHMM: drive/play-level bivariate observations (EPA per play + success rate) with CMP/negative-binomial marginals and a Gaussian/Clayton copula, K=3 states with covariate-driven transitions (score differential, time remaining, home/away, opponent strength); posterior state probabilities feed in-game win-probability and live spread/total models.",
    "desc": "copula-hmm-momentum",
    "why": "Gate needs >= 0.02 nats/observation one-step-ahead log-likelihood gain on 2023-2024 holdout.",
},
# 12
"2003.01712v1": {
    "blocks": ["joi"],
    "mech": "NFL JOI stack metric: per QB-pass-catcher pair, sum EPA of consecutive-play sequences where both touch the ball plus drive-level co-production, normalized per dropback together -> JOI/dropback; unseen pairs predicted with gradient boosting on pair features for DFS stacking and props.",
    "desc": "joi-stack-metric",
    "why": "Gate needs Spearman rho >= 0.40 vs next-season JOI/dropback on unseen pairs.",
},
# 13
"2003.03685v2": {
    "blocks": ["pcor"],
    "mech": "PCMCI+ per team-season on the nflverse team-week panel (N~30 indicators, T~18 weeks, taumax=4, ParCorr first with GPDC confirmation on the top-50 stable edges); edge frequencies aggregated across ~380 team-seasons (retain >= 0.4); quarterly graph artifact feeding the Markov-blanket feature-pruning pipeline.",
    "desc": "pcmci-team-panel",
    "why": "Gate needs held-out 2024-2025 Brier within 0.002 of all-lags baseline using <= 60% of features.",
},
# 14
"2003.06505v1": {
    "blocks": ["stacking"],
    "mech": "AutoGluon-Tabular wrapper for offseason/monthly search over win-probability/spread/total tabular models: custom time-aware bagging (rolling-origin folds), GSE's hand-tuned LightGBM/XGBoost configs as extra base models, isotonic layer on stacker outputs; full search once per offseason, lightweight 30-minute weekly refit in-season.",
    "desc": "autogluon-tabular-search",
    "why": "Gate needs >= 0.003 log-loss gain on 2023-2025 holdout at <= 100 GPU/CPU-hours total.",
},
# 15
"2003.09384v2": {
    "blocks": ["scoring", "kelly"],
    "mech": "Profit-maximizing static-theta edge-threshold policy: optimize GSE's bet-selection threshold on model-vs-market edge for total realized profit (not per-week ROI) on chronological backtests, deploying the static theta that maximizes total profit when per-window-optimal theta is unstable; line-shopping uplift quantified by running the identical bet list against consensus-average vs best-available odds.",
    "desc": "static-theta-threshold-policy",
    "why": "Gate needs 2015-2024 backtest: static theta beats current policy total profit by >= 20%.",
},
# 16
"2003.10865v2": {
    "blocks": ["hpo", "gp"],
    "mech": "Async offseason HPO service: N workers pull (config, fidelity) tasks from a queue (fidelity = training seasons 2 -> 4 -> 8 -> full), joint GP (or CQR surrogate) over (config, seasons), bracket sampling per P(s), fantasize pending evaluations -- async because model families have heterogeneous runtimes.",
    "desc": "async-hpo-service",
    "why": "Gate needs sync-BOHB final log-loss in <= 60% wall-clock with 8 workers.",
},
# 17
"2004.03019": {
    "blocks": ["hmm"],
    "mech": "DSHDPHMM: disentangled sticky HDP-HMM on per-drive/per-game team observables (EPA/play, pass rate, explosiveness, pace) with Poisson/Gaussian emissions, weak-limit L=50, fit per team-season 2018-2024; inferred state indicators plus kappa_j persistence feed matchup and live models as regime features.",
    "desc": "dshdp-hmm-regimes",
    "why": "Gate needs held-out NLL win in >= 60% of team-seasons with real kappa_j heterogeneity.",
},
# 18
"2004.08428v1": {
    "blocks": ["sparse"],
    "mech": "Era-adjusted player features: per-opportunity prowess (passing yards/attempt, EPA/play) renormalized against league-average-by-season to a common baseline before use in prop/fantasy models; Dickey-Fuller stationarity gate on every candidate feature's league-average series (deflate non-stationary ones); deflators validated by the distribution-collapse test (era-separated PDFs of the adjusted metric must collapse).",
    "desc": "era-adjusted-features",
    "why": "Gate needs DF p < 0.05 on renormalized series plus PDF collapse across eras.",
},
# 19
"2005.07742": {
    "blocks": ["betabinom"],
    "mech": "SEAM sparse-matchup shrinkage template as GSE's matchup-adjustment standard: any player-vs-player or player-vs-defense projection with thin direct history shrinks toward synthetic comparables (three-way KDE blend with sample-size-driven weights) rather than a flat prior; unit tests assert w_1 -> 1 as n_direct -> large and w_1 -> 0 as n_direct -> 0.",
    "desc": "seam-matchup-shrinkage",
    "why": "Gate needs 0.90-nominal conditional coverage >= 0.80 on thin-history MLB replication matchups.",
},
# 20
"2005.09024v1": {
    "blocks": ["ridge", "logistic"],
    "mech": "Per-player availability model: snap counts x intensity proxy (workload), days since last game + travel + short-week flags (recovery), 10-game rolling lags, hierarchical partial pooling across players within position group; target = binary availability / ordinal practice participation; availability signals weighted by posterior relative importance R_j; high-risk workload-lag profiles flag picks to adjust or withhold.",
    "desc": "workload-availability-model",
    "why": "Gate needs held-out 2025 availability AUC >= 3pp over pooled baseline with real lag heterogeneity.",
},
# 21
"2006.04551v4": {
    "blocks": ["distill"],
    "mech": "Distill the production probability model into a mimic model tree: engine soft labels on the full training corpus plus counterfactual augmentation (perturb game-state features: score diff +/-7, down/distance swaps, timeout changes), linear model tree (iterative segmented-regression splits, min 100 records/child, L1/L0 pruning); feature-importance ranking by summed variance reduction plus content-usable extracted rules; joint training on engine soft labels AND de-vigged market-implied probabilities for an interpretable engine-vs-market disagreement map.",
    "desc": "mimic-model-tree",
    "why": "Gate needs fidelity correlation >= 0.95 and RMSE <= 0.03 on the 2025 time-ordered holdout.",
},
# 22
"2006.04779v2": {
    "blocks": ["cql"],
    "mech": "Conservative Q-learning stake policy trained offline on GSE's historical slate data: state = (week, bankroll, edges, CLV, market features), action = discrete stake {0, 0.25u, 0.5u, 1u, 2u}, reward = settled profit; small MLP Q-network with CQL(H) penalty; greedy argmax under a per-week max-exposure cap with abstention as the learned 'don't bet'; OOD density check with fallback to fractional-Kelly.",
    "desc": "cql-stake-policy",
    "why": "Gate needs 2024 holdout ROI >= 2pp over fractional-Kelly with the lower-bound diagnostic holding.",
},
# 23
"2006.06707v2": {
    "blocks": ["gp"],
    "mech": "MetaVRF few-shot regime model: tasks = team-seasons in sequential order, tabular MLP embedding psi on nflverse team-game stats, D=780 RFF bases, meta-learned KRR base-learner predicting next-game margin with an LSTM accumulating league meta-knowledge across seasons; weekly meta-test as a forward pass plus a 4x4 ridge solve (no gradient steps); classification variant (cover/no-cover) tested against the engine's classifier.",
    "desc": "metavrf-kernel-learning",
    "why": "Gate needs >= 0.01 Brier over league-average prior on new-regime first-4-game predictions.",
},

    "blocks": ["nmf", "em"],

    "desc": "bayesian-shot-archetypes",
    "why": "Gate needs concordance RI >= 0.95 with downstream 3P-attempt-rate RMSE improvement.",
},
